audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row said Kled on both layers while whys[6] on the same page says '2+ items is yours since Wukong out-scales the fading early bully', and the packet chart says Wukong.
audit.why: Same disagreement the mirror (kled__wukong) already resolved in Wukong's favour; the other six rows already match the packet.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side and win[6] flipped to Wukong as a matched pair, rating to 6/10, and phases[6].why rewritten to say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2..4] and [6] whys were template text naming no spike.
audit.why: The real shape: Violent Tendencies (13s, four ramping attacks) owns level 3, a baited Jousting or Bear Trap is the 4-5 window, Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is a 140s rank-1 engage with a shield, and two items is where his early bully window closes.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten around those spikes with the cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text told the player to 'use W to break the pull channel'. Bear Trap on a Rope is not a channel — Riot's text says the target is shackled for a short duration and then yanked.
audit.why: A player who reads 'break the channel' will hold W until after the hook lands and then find themselves pulled in for the mounted combo. Whether Warrior Trickster's untargetable frame cancels the yank is not something the kit data answers, so the page must not promise it.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and wants.you[0] now say dodge the skillshot, because once shackled the yank follows. Cooldown fields carry Bear Trap 11s / 800 range / no cost, Violent Tendencies 13s, Jousting 13s with the return dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and two placeholder bullets.
audit.why: All of Kled's laning spells cost 0 mana — the only thing gating him is cooldowns, which makes tracking them the whole game.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written in; the zero cost is stated because it changes how you read his aggression.

audit.why: Real names, and the trade should end before his fourth Violent Tendencies attack.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kled carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, his early bully window is gone and short trades favour you. Kled carry threat 7/10 — take the side lane.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kled must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies (13s) wins any trade that lasts four autos. Keep it short and keep the wave where he must step up.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Bait Jousting (13s) or Bear Trap (11s), then commit — with either one spent he cannot re-engage, and he cannot peel your burst off Skaarl.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and arrives with a shield. Cyclone answers it, but only if you hold it for the charge.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Bear Trap on a Rope: 11s at rank 1, 800 range, and it costs him nothing — dodge it or eat the yank. - Violent Tendencies: 13s, four ramping attacks. - Jousting: 13s, and he can dash back through you.

edits.before: His engage hook. Decoy it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 11s at rank 1, 800 range, no mana cost. Engage once it is spent.

edits.before: Track Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope: His engage hook. Decoy it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 and costs nothing — when it is spent, E-Q + R him.

edits.before: Kled spikes with Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) pull + Violent Tendencies attack speed; if his Q hooks you he yanks you in for a full mounted combo, so use W to break the pull channel or dodge the skillshot entirely.
edits.after: Kled spikes with Bear Trap on a Rope (Q, 11s, 800 range) plus Violent Tendencies; once the trap shackles you the yank follows on its own, so dodge the skillshot rather than planning to answer it after it lands.

edits.before: Dodge or W-cancel his Q pull to deny the mounted all-in
edits.after: Dodge his Q outright — a shackle means the yank lands
